sloka: एवमुक्ते तु शूरेण शत्रुघ्नेन महात्मना ।उवाच रामः संहृष्टो भरतं लक्ष्मणं तथा ।। ७.६३.९ ॥
transliteration: evamukte tu śūreṇa śatrughnena mahātmanā ।uvāca rāmaḥ saṁhṛṣṭo bharataṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ tathā ।। 7.63.9 ॥

translations.english: When the brave and great-souled Shatrughna had thus spoken, Rama, greatly delighted, addressed Bharata and Lakshmana.
